title: A Survey on Preserving Fairness Guarantees in Changing Environments
findings: This paper does not analyze or present any findings related to religion. It is a survey of methods for preserving fairness guarantees in machine learning when the data distribution changes. The word 'religion' appears once in a quote from the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights as an example of a protected characteristic, but it is not a subject of analysis in the paper.
